name: AI Content by Parallax
author: Parallax AI Content

sections.description:
Parallax is a product of MMDB Solutions. This is the official plugin for integrating Parallax with WooCommerce.

AI Content by Parallax integrates your WooCommerce store with the Parallax AI platform, enabling automated product and category content optimization using advanced language models. The plugin handles authentication, batch submissions, result importing, admin workflows, and status tracking directly inside WordPress.

This plugin requires an account on the Parallax AI platform and uses a secure API key to communicate with the external service. Optimizations consume credits purchased through the Parallax AI dashboard.

Key Features

  • Connect WooCommerce to Parallax AI through a secure API key
  • Optimize product titles, descriptions, excerpts, and custom fields
  • Optimize WooCommerce category descriptions and metadata
  • Batch processing system for large catalogs
  • Full request + response logging system
  • Admin tables for tracking “Orders,” “Batches,” and “Optimization Items”
  • AJAX-based actions with nonces + capability checks
  • Uses native WooCommerce + WordPress UI patterns
  • No front-end output

SaaS Disclosure (Required)

This plugin depends on a third-party SaaS service: Parallax AI (https://eparallax.com).

When you trigger optimization actions, the plugin sends:

  • Product title, description, excerpt, and custom meta fields
  • Category name and category description
  • Site name + admin email (for identification in the Parallax dashboard)

to the Parallax AI API endpoint:

  • https://api.eparallax.com/ (or your selected environment)

The Parallax API processes the data and returns optimized fields.
This plugin cannot operate without a Parallax AI account and API key.
The SaaS service may require payment (credits-based model).

All communication is initiated by the admin user, and no data is sent automatically without an explicit action.

External Service Policy Compliance

  • The plugin does not track visitors or store personal browsing data.
  • The plugin only transmits content required for optimization.
  • Parallax AI’s privacy policy can be viewed here:
    https://eparallax.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ai-content-by-parallax/
  2. Activate through Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Parallax AI
  4. Enter your API key
  5. Begin optimizing your products or categories
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without a Parallax AI account?

No. An API key and valid credits are required.

Does this affect the front-end of my store?

No. All functionality is in the WordPress admin.

Is any personal data sent to Parallax?

Only product/category content and the site name/URL for identification.
No customer data or order data is ever transmitted.

Can I sync Parallax term SEO to Yoast SEO?

Yes. Syncing is enabled by default. Check “Disable sync term SEO to Yoast” in
the settings to stop mirroring the term meta title/description into Yoast’s
wpseo_title/wpseo_desc fields for supported product taxonomies, and only when
Yoast SEO is installed.
